text: {"standards":[{"code":"RL.6.1","verdict":"taught","reason":"In Part A, students reread pp. 354–363, record choices with page numbers, and quote or paraphrase them to support analysis of what the text shows about home, choice, and identity."},{"code":"RL.6.2","verdict":"taught","reason":"In Part C, students write a 4–5 sentence summary of how home, choice, and identity are resolved in Chapter 22, with page-cited evidence and no opinion, and the Pulse Check reinforces the summary-versus-opinion distinction."},{"code":"L.6.4","verdict":"taught","reason":"In the Words in Context activity, students use sentence clues and word parts such as pro- and vac- to determine meanings of multiple-meaning words like disposed and procession, and record the clue that helped them in a Personal Dictionary."},{"code":"L.6.6","verdict":"taught","reason":"Students learn ten Tier 2 and Tier 3 words, use them in the Part C summary and the Exit Ticket, and record them in a Personal Dictionary, which is accurate use of academic and domain-specific vocabulary."}],"anchorText":{"verdict":"uses","reason":"The Lesson reads and works from pp. 354–363 in Part A and has the teacher read pp. 364–369 aloud in Part B, which matches the Outline's focus and in-class reading pages."}}
